reason: Apply Windows FFI, error, resource, cancellation, logging, privacy, and test requirements.
Implement exactly the approved APIs, metric set, cadence, bounds, and unsupported states.
Implement one bounded sampler, privacy-limited process DTO, and CLI lifecycle.

did: Added Status V1 adapters and DTOs in crates/devsweep-core/src/status: CPU (GetSystemTimes), memory (GlobalMemoryStatusEx), fixed volumes (GetLogicalDriveStringsW/GetDriveTypeW/GetDiskFreeSpaceExW), network (GetIfTable2+FreeMibTable), power (GetSystemPowerStatus), bounded ToolHelp processes (name/PID/CPU/memory/I/O only). Availability tags never map missing hardware/access to zero. GPU/VRAM/thermal/fan/SMART/physical-disk-activity are static unsupported.

Kept existing Optimize/analysis windows-sys flags. Added missing Status flags Win32_NetworkManagement_IpHelper, Win32_System_Diagnostics_ToolHelp, Win32_System_Power. Win32_System_ProcessStatus and Win32_System_SystemInformation already existed at HEAD. Also added Win32_NetworkManagement_Ndis because windows-sys 0.59 gates GetIfTable2/MIB_IF_ROW2/NET_LUID_LH behind Ndis; NET_LUID_LH is used in network.rs. No new crate, no WMI/PowerShell/vendor tools.

Implemented one StatusSampler: 500 ms snapshot window, live default 2 s clamped 1–60 s, process refresh 4 s, volumes/battery 30 s, one in-flight sample, skipped ticks without backfill, cancel/join, process-global live permit (coordinator refusal). Process bounds: enumerate <=4096, 150 ms detail budget, default 15/max 100 returned, truncation metadata before sort/limit. Four frozen NDJSON events. CLI fills frozen status snapshot/live handlers; minimal commands/mod.rs status. dispatch; no cli.rs parser edits. Broken pipe: no second write, cancel/join, exit 0. Partial snapshot exit 5. Human i18n status.v1.* en/zh-CN.
